---
applyTo: "**/*.cs,**/*.py,**/*.go,**/*.java,**/*.ts,**/*.js"
---
# Backend and application code instructions
- Discover the actual stack and follow existing conventions; this file does not mandate a language or framework.
- Trace callers, validation, authorization, data ownership/tenant boundaries, error handling, logging, and compatibility.
- Add/update tests for behavior and failure cases.
- Do not log secrets or sensitive data.
- Document API/schema changes and operational implications.
